transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. I came in because I barely sleep right anymore. I'll just lie there at night... hearing the rain or thinking about the bluff giving way. Then when I actually do pass out, I end up waking up all sweaty from these dreams. It's getting to the point where I show up to my job at the call center feeling like I never even went to sleep at all. So, I figured I needed to come see someone about it.
How long have you been having these dreams and trouble sleeping?
It's been going on for about four months now. Basically, it started right after I got trapped when that bluff trail collapsed.
Do you find yourself going out of your way to avoid places, activities, or reminders connected to that trail collapse?

Yeah, I do. I won't go anywhere near the coast trails now. I just stay away from them completely. And I've been dodging texts from my old hiking buddies, too. Because honestly, even just talking about going out there makes my chest tighten up.
